tonight.headline: Down 41.8 to 0 — and Tuten missed Thursday too
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday either — the only active Jaguar who sat out (jaguars.com, 26 Nov) — and Isaiah Likely was limited for a second day (Rotowire). Footballers have banked 41.8: Caleb Williams 25.3 (345 yards in Chicago's 38-35 win at Detroit) on top of Christian Watson's 16.5. You are 4-7.

One thing improved: Stefon Diggs came off Washington's report Thursday (Rotowire), so if Tuten sits, Ollie Gordon slides to RB and Diggs takes FLEX. Josh Allen plays Kansas City tonight at 19:20 in steady rain. ESPN has it 130.0 to 143.4, 43%. Nothing to move today.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Emmett Johnson (17.7) runs well for them tonight, Smith-Njigba and Bowers play, and Tuten sits without the Sunday move made — 18.7 projected becomes a zero.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Justin Herbert is in concussion protocol and missed both practices (urgent.news 26 Nov, a thin source). If Jake Browning starts, their Omarion Hampton and Cameron Dicker lose some of a 22.6 projected.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising in any form on Friday moves Sunday back to 'start as set'. Bowers or Smith-Njigba ruled out narrows their edge.

doFirst.subtitle: Tuten starts if active. Changed since this morning: Diggs is back, so the fallback is Diggs, not Etienne.

case.label: The player
case.body: Did not practise Wednesday or Thursday, foot and ankle — the only active Jaguar who sat Thursday (jaguars.com 26 Nov; Rotowire). He has missed at least one practice in each of the last three weeks and played every time. ESPN still projects 18.7; Friday's report sets his status.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Ollie Gordon II (14.0) moves from FLEX to the RB slot and Stefon Diggs (12.7, WSH at ARI, Sun 15:25) takes FLEX. That is 0.7 more than Travis Etienne Jr. (12.0) straight into RB — a coin flip, so it goes to the projection. This morning's only reason against Diggs, Wednesday's personal absence, ended when he came off the report Thursday (Rotowire 26 Nov).

case.label: Who throws to Diggs
case.body: Jayden Daniels, full practice all week with the left elbow and hand (commanders.com Wednesday report).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising Friday in any form makes this moot. Diggs re-added to Friday's report hands the seat back to Etienne.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is inactive and Etienne outscores Diggs (archive); or Tuten is active and Diggs outscores him; or the seat scores zero because the move was not made.
